title: Farsight: Fostering Responsible AI Awareness During AI Application Prototyping

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the effectiveness of the Farsight tool in assisting AI prototypers to anticipate and identify representational harms (e.g., stereotyping, erasing, or alienating social groups) during prompt-based application prototyping via user studies.

Assessing users' capacity to brainstorm and identify allocative harms (e.g., unfair denial of opportunities or resources to specific demographic groups) using the Farsight harm envisioning tool and baseline taxonomies during an HR/Toxicity classifier prompt task.
